variants.prompt:
Use the attached Midi robot as an EXACT character reference. Create a website favicon of ONLY MIDI'S HEAD, front-facing symmetrical like reference. NO neck, body, shoulder, arm, hands or chest. Entire head including BOTH tall white ear antennas, blue side ear caps, cyan rounded forehead dome and white rounded chin rim FULLY VISIBLE and UNCROPPED. Square canvas 1024x1024, centered head with at least 6% transparent breathing space at every edge; antennas must not touch edges. Preserve exact reference character identity, proportions, friendly expression, thin clean blue outlines. White shell, light cyan-blue forehead plate, tiny round blue forehead dot, near-black navy face screen, two vertical cyan oval eyes, small broad open cyan smiling mouth with flat top/rounded bottom. Exact expression, no eyebrows, no nose, no changed eye emotion. Bottom ends at the rounded chin; absolutely NO neck connector below. No text, no AI, no logo, no extra symbols. Genuine transparent alpha background, clean edges, no shadow, no glow outside head. Small-size favicon clarity at16-32px.
